headline.text: Not on track: 9 % to close everything with 3 days left, and the two blocked items carry 7 SP.

cards.note: A decision is due today: the options are below the cards.

rows.text: 9 % chance to finish everything that is open. 16 SP in 11 items are not done, with 3 working days left.
85 % sure of at least 15 SP by the end, as likely as not 20 SP. 13 SP are done on day 7 of 10.
Moving out what is blocked (7 SP) lifts the chance to 41 %. Together with the work that has not started it is 10 SP and 60 %.
31 SP were committed. Only 1 of 8 past sprints completed that much.
The team usually completes 34 SP, so the commitment was within reach.
The forecast has earned some trust: its 85 % line held in 18 of 18 look-backs into past sprints.

cards.note: Blocked work and late scope both showed up before the sprints this team missed.

rows.text: KES-1290 and KES-1391 are blocked, 7 SP together. KES-1290 is in its sprint number 4.
KES-1360 has been in Review for 18 days and KES-1373 in progress for 13 days.
3 items came in after the start: KES-1403, KES-1408 and KES-1422.
The pre-mortem finds 4 of 7 signs that came before this team's missed sprints. The strongest is the load: 119 % of what earlier sprints completed on average.
2 pull requests have waited 24 hours or more for a first review, and 3 items in progress are without a pull request.
2 bugs are new for the team since yesterday: KES-1420, handed over by another team, and KES-1422.
Other teams named the team in 2 issues: OPS-874 and PAY-2291.
1 incident report came in this week, and 2 services had two or more reports in 90 days.
2 bugs are open in the sprint: KES-1391 and KES-1422.
